report.source_text: Blood results indicated leukocytosis [white blood cell *=(WBC) count: 14.4], anemia [hemoglobin (HB): 9.8], and a β-HCG of 1,254,800 mUI/m.

clinician.trajectory_summary: A 20-year-old female presented with sudden onset dyspnea and left hemithorax pain the day after a normal vaginal delivery. Physical examination revealed tachycardia, hypoxia, reduced left lung sounds, and a 1 cm suburethral vaginal lesion. Imaging with chest x-ray and high-resolution CT showed left hemothorax and bilateral pulmonary nodules up to 41 mm consistent with metastases. Laboratory testing demonstrated leukocytosis, anemia, and a markedly elevated serum β-HCG level of 1,254,800 mUI/m, supporting the diagnosis of metastatic choriocarcinoma.
